title: Ferric instrument pack, format 1
description: instrument.json at the head of a pack folder in L-1's HARDWARE aisle. Written from the decoder L-1 ships (InstrumentSpec, PanelFace). Unknown keys are ignored by L-1 and so allowed here; a known key of the wrong type makes L-1 skip the whole pack, so types are strict.

name.description: What the sidebar says, and the FROM plate its prints wear.

panel.description: generic (default) or a built-in panel name. An unknown name falls back to the declared face or the generic station.

role.description: SYNTH, SAMPLER, DRUM MACHINE, PIANO: what it does.

volume.description: Absolute path that exists when the unit mounts.

cardMarker.description: Folder name that identifies the unit's card on any mounted volume.

volumeNames.description: Volume names to accept, compared without case.

midiName.description: Substring of the unit's MIDI source display name, compared without case.

driver.description: One script in the pack, installed to the bench and made executable. The declared face runs it with bash.

drivers.description: Further tools installed to the bench.

docs.description: Authored text installed to the bench.

reference.description: Immutable folders installed when the bench's copy is empty.

mark.description: The kind word a published stem ends with.

publishes.description: Bench folders whose sounds reach the PATCHES shelf.

folders.description: Bench subfolders created on first launch.

offline.description: The line under the name when the machine is not there.

online.description: The line under the name when it is.

rolandApp.description: Absolute path to the maker's own utility. Read only by one built-in panel today; the key keeps its first name in format 1.

face.description: A declared face: wells count the bench, verbs run the driver.

needs.description: mounted or pluggedIn. Any other value leaves the verb always live.
